description.value: Union Pacific Coffee Co. is a heritage café established in 2006 inside the historic Hart's Block building along Dragon Alley in Victoria's Chinatown. Revitalized by twins Kelley and Lindsay, it serves specialty coffees sourced from JJ Bean in Vancouver alongside freshly baked in-house pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and a full lunch menu. The laid-back Pacific Northwest ambiance and vibrant heritage setting make it a natural stop for cyclists passing through the city centre.
